simple.meaning: רָגַז (râgaz) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to quiver (with any violent emotion, especially anger or fear).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 41 times across Genesis, Exodus, Deuteronomy, 1 Samuel, 2 Samuel, and 12 more, beginning at Genesis 45:24. Its contexts include family, family line, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to רָגַז (H7264).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: רָגַז (râgaz) / H7264 is traced through Genesis 45:24, Exodus 15:14, Deuteronomy 2:25, 1 Samuel 14:15 as a generated source-based concept entry.
